knowledge:
- key_parameters: tissue_csv_file=Path to the tissue_positions_list.csv file containing spot coordinates and tissue/background labels ;; tissue_img_file=Path to the tissue image file (e.g., tissue_lowres_image.png) ;; scale_factor_file=Path to the scale factors JSON file (scalefactors_json.json) ;; maxit=Maximum number of iterations for decontamination (default is 30, can be extended if convergence is not reached) ;; candidate_radius=Radius for evaluating contamination (evaluates a series of candidate radii by default and automatically chooses the best one) ;; image_dir=Path to the spatial folder containing images and scale factors, required when converting to a Seurat object ;; data=Must specify data = "raw" when reading with SpatialExperiment::read10xVisium()
- alternatives: SpatialExperiment::read10xVisium()=Used to read 10x Visium data directly into a SpatialExperiment object, which spotclean() can process directly ;; ggspavis=Recommended for visualizing SpatialExperiment objects, as spotclean's built-in visualization functions do not support the SpatialExperiment class ;; Seurat=Used for downstream analyses (e.g., clustering, dimensional reduction) after converting the decontaminated object using convertToSeurat()
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing 10x Visium spatial transcriptomics data (or other spatial transcriptomics data where both tissue and background regions are available) to correct for spot swapping / mRNA bleed-out contamination. This improves marker gene-based inferences, tissue type annotation, cell type decomposition, integration with single-cell RNA-seq, and identification of spatially variable or differentially expressed (DE) genes.
- pitfalls: Too many tissue spots (not enough background spots)=If all or almost all spots are covered by tissue, the contaminated expressions are confounded with true expressions. It is recommended to have at least 25% of spots not occupied by tissue ;; Lowly-expressed genes=Contain less information and more noise. SpotClean by default filters them out (keeps highly-expressed or highly-variable genes), though it can be forced to run on them ;; Inference based on sequencing depth=Decontamination reassigns UMIs and changes estimated sequencing depth, which might conflict with existing sequencing depth normalization methods ;; Seurat conversion requirement=convertToSeurat() requires the path to the original spatial folder containing images and scale factors

workflows.name: standard_10x_visium_workflow
workflows.intent: Load raw 10x Visium Space Ranger output, perform decontamination, visualize results, and convert to a Seurat object.
workflows.stages: 1. Load raw count matrix ;; 2. Load slide metadata ;; 3. Create slide object ;; 4. Visualize raw slide, labels, and heatmaps ;; 5. Decontaminate data ;; 6. Visualize decontaminated expression and contamination rates ;; 7. Calculate ambient RNA contamination score ;; 8. Convert to Seurat object
workflows.code:
mbrain_raw <- read10xRaw("/path/to/matrix/folder")
mbrain_slide_info <- read10xSlide(tissue_csv_file=file.path(spatial_dir, "tissue_positions_list.csv"), tissue_img_file = file.path(spatial_dir, "tissue_lowres_image.png"), scale_factor_file = file.path(spatial_dir, "scalefactors_json.json"))
slide_obj <- createSlide(mbrain_raw, mbrain_slide_info)
visualizeSlide(slide_obj)
visualizeLabel(slide_obj,"tissue")
metadata(slide_obj)$slide$total_counts <- Matrix::colSums(mbrain_raw)
visualizeHeatmap(slide_obj,"total_counts")
visualizeHeatmap(slide_obj,"Mbp")
decont_obj <- spotclean(slide_obj, maxit=10, candidate_radius = 20)
visualizeHeatmap(decont_obj,"Mbp")
summary(metadata(decont_obj)$contamination_rate)
arcScore(slide_obj)
seurat_obj <- convertToSeurat(decont_obj,image_dir = spatial_dir)

workflows.name: spatial_experiment_workflow
workflows.intent: Decontaminate spatial transcriptomics data stored in a SpatialExperiment object.
input: /path/to/spaceranger/output/ (Space Ranger output directory containing raw data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load raw data into a SpatialExperiment object ;; 2. Run decontamination ;; 3. Inspect decontaminated assays
workflows.code:
library(SpatialExperiment)
slide_obj <- read10xVisium(samples = "/path/to/spaceranger/output/", data = "raw")
decont_obj <- spotclean(slide_obj)
str(assays(decont_obj)$decont)
